lines.text: Many learners say: Do you mind I open the window?
Better: Do you mind if I open the window?
If! Do you mind if I sit here?

data.wrong: Do you mind I open the window?
data.right: Do you mind if I open the window?

quiz.stem: Do you mind ___ I sit here?

native.tip: 中文说“你介意我开窗吗”，中间不需要连接词。英语要在 mind 后面加 if。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “Do you mind I open the window?”😅 中文里不需要连接词，英语要在 mind 后面加 if：“Do you mind if I open the window?”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Chinese needs no link word, but English needs if after mind.
en.caption: Do you say “Do you mind I open the window?” 😅 English needs if after mind: “Do you mind if I open the window?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
